children.text: We're growing and looking for an experienced residential service electrician to keep up with demand across the Phoenix Valley. Residential Service Electrician (Full-time) You'll run residential service calls in occupied homes: troubleshooting and diagnostics, panel and service work, EV chargers, lighting, outlets and circuits, and the occasional remodel. Real variety and real diagnostic work, not the same rough-in all day. What you need: 4+ years of residential service experience. If that's you, hit Apply and tell us about your service experience.
